integrity: Infinite equivalence is analytically proved using trace-norm Fourier extraction and summable row rectangles. Computational checks are finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Treats polynomial coefficient weights with exponent strictly below one; not arbitrary weights.
The block trace norms are finite-dimensional invariants rather than a scalar closed-form formula.
No independent prior-art audit and no claim of exact best constants.
title: Trace-class invariance and a dyadic nuclear criterion for polynomially weighted Rhaly operators
